input_eligibility.gse296875: Same-nucleus RNA/ATAC can support a new liver adaptation inside donor-by-genomic folds, but training a new scGLUE space does not preserve the checkpoint decoder coordinate system. An explicit bridge or decoder adaptation is required and must be reported as a new fitted model.
input_eligibility.rna_conditioned_atac: Fails the no-observed-ATAC inference gate because ATAC contributed to the cell context. Masking ATAC after computing the embedding does not remove that leakage.
